items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) ruled OUT again for Week 6 vs Patriots; remains week-to-week.
items.why: Quad injury; no practice this week.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues as lead back with heavy snap share.
items.opportunity: Nearly all RB snaps to Allen (90 in recent full games per Levitan).

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) ruled OUT and will not travel to London for Week 6 vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Woody Marks expected for full RB workload (98% snaps last week after Monty exit).
items.opportunity: Marks full snaps/touches as lead back.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled OUT for Week 6 vs Panthers (and indefinitely until medical situation resolved) due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; Tanner McKee to start.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound revealed movement in small superficial blood clot after prior clearance to play in London; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles pass game and Hurts fantasy value crater short-term; monitor multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Goedert and remaining WRs in McKee offense.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again (hamstring); second straight DNP.
items.implication: Game-time or limited; monitor for Worthy/others.
items.opportunity: Potential snap/target share to Xavier Worthy if out/limited.

items.text: Saquon Barkley turns 30 in February; Eagles gold standard at moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, McCoy, Ertz); contenders with RB need should call. Agrees risk of moving a year early better than late.
items.why: Age curve and Eagles precedent for early exits from stars.
items.implication: Potential trade candidate or reduced long-term value; short-term still elite but monitor.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans as WR4 vs Commanders; ALL IN due to soft secondary and season-high 36% target share last week (45%+ when Deebo off field); Deebo out multi-weeks.
items.why: Commanders defense buffet for pass catchers; elevated target share with Deebo (hamstring) multi-week out.
items.opportunity: High target share and routes in favorable matchup.

items.text: Loves Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB, goal-line role) and Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs Jets); volume vs leaking run defenses. Henderson multi-week high ankle out boosts Stevenson to 85% snaps/23 touches precedent.
items.why: Stevenson volume spike with Henderson out multi-weeks; Javonte goal-line; both vs soft run D.

items.text: Cardinals trade Marvin Harrison Jr. to HOU; Evan Silva/Adam Levitan: Kendrick Bourne will get open more and earn more targets than MHJ did.
items.why: MHJ departure opens targets; Bourne better separator.
items.implication: Bourne fantasy bump in ARI; MHJ new situation in HOU.

items.text: Since Breece Hall injury, RB snaps in two full games: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0. Hall remains week-to-week, no practice.
items.why: Clear hierarchy with Allen dominating snaps fully.
items.implication: Allen is the clear every-down back and strong start while Hall out.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle questionable to return (shoulder) in TNF but returned to the game.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game but cleared to return.
items.implication: Played through; full status going forward but production concerns remain.
items.conflict: Berry still hates weekly due to season-long inefficiency.

items.text: Loves Drake London as WR6 vs Bears; bankable usage in soft matchup.
items.why: Reliable role/usage vs defense that allows production.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams as RB5 vs Cardinals; elite recent usage vs run-leaking defense.
items.why: Volume and matchup vs soft run D.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle as WR28 vs Seahawks; only 204 yards all year (67% in one game), averaging 16.5 otherwise.
items.why: Ugly matchup + poor production consistency outside one boom game.
items.conflict: Waddle returned from shoulder Q in TNF but still faded weekly.

items.text: Hates Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA, toughest pass D, playing scared/no deep shots) and Justin Herbert (QB25 @ KC, lowest team total/scoring rut).
items.why: Matchup/volume issues; Nix under Webb looks limited.
